ownerDecisionRequest.reason: The owner approved the need for an applicable resource/free-space preflight but did not yet approve its numeric pass/fail floors. The following conservative engineering values must not be represented as owner-approved until explicitly accepted or amended.

items.proposal: Require 16 logical processors and at least 30 GiB reported physical memory when recognizing the owner's 32 GiB reference host.
items.derivation: The exact logical count is observed reference identity. The 30 GiB memory check allows reporting/firmware variance without becoming a public hardware floor.

items.proposal: Require at least 8 GiB available physical memory immediately before smoke.
items.derivation: The owner-approved 4 GiB combined-process ceiling plus a separate 4 GiB host reserve.

items.proposal: Reserve the approved 0.75 GiB retention ceiling, an equal 0.75 GiB peak scratch allowance, and 2 GiB that must remain free on the one shared sibling-root volume.
items.derivation: This yields exactly 3.5 GiB required free space. Only the 0.75 GiB retention ceiling was previously owner-approved.

items.proposal: Block while any ffmpeg or ffprobe process is active; record current CPU utilization without imposing a CPU-utilization gate.
items.derivation: Avoid unrelated-media contamination without inventing a dynamic CPU threshold.

storage.calculation: The exact non-reparse repository-sibling roots necessarily share one volume: 2 GiB fixed reserve plus one approved 0.75 GiB retained-group ceiling plus one equally sized scratch ceiling.

requiredChecks: the complete current local artifact inventory passes independent size and SHA-256 verification
the durable manifest exactly binds the current local inventory but may still truthfully report R2 verification pending
the approved artifact and staging roots are exact non-reparse repository siblings
the host matches the owner reference profile and has at least the required available memory
no ffmpeg or ffprobe process is active at the observation instant
every involved volume meets the applicable free-space formula
the exact three smoke candidates and workload remain bound to the owner-approved contract

result.passMeaning: After owner approval of the numeric floors, the reference host had bounded capacity for the approved smoke shape at the recorded instant; this does not authorize or execute media.
result.blockedMeaning: A failed prerequisite is retained without weakening, substitution, cleanup concealment, or media execution.

nonClaims: No current ReelForge product rendering, responsiveness, preview, cache, cancellation, or project behavior claim.
No full 2A, 2B, 2C, long-form, shipping-runtime, distribution, patent, legal, or public hardware-floor conclusion.
This preflight does not replace complete R2 byte verification or the independent smoke oracle and retention pipeline.
